title: 第十二章 孩子就跟你姓吧，姐姐！
slug: 神印我魔族太女重铸魔族
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“用一般的酒放在他特制的容器内，然后施展魔法封印，放在池水之中就好了。”

星魔神瓦沙克淡淡地说着，“他封印魔法我会哦，我来教你。”

“解除的方法比你现在这方法还更减少灵力的消耗。”

星魔神瓦沙克这话无疑是说到枫溪的心扉去了。

“要！”

枫溪的眼眸亮亮的，用崇拜的眼神看着星魔神瓦沙克，“瓦沙克叔叔，您是魔族最聪明的魔！”

“以您的智慧来布局，绝对能把阿加雷斯叔叔给骗的团团转的。”

枫溪现在是一个劲地夸赞着星魔神瓦沙克。

因为她要星魔神瓦沙克帮忙。

星魔神瓦沙克顿了顿，“好啊。”

“不过，到时候你要带我家门笛去玩。”

“阿宝和门笛同龄。反正带一个孩子是带，带两个孩子也是带。”

“我家门笛性子天真温和，我怕他受委屈。”

星魔神瓦沙克顿了顿，“没有同龄的伙伴，对他来说也是一件悲伤的事情。”

“好呀！”

枫溪当即应了下来，“瓦沙克叔叔，我肯定能照顾好门笛弟弟的！”

“好。”

有枫溪这句话在，星魔神瓦沙克就放下心来了。

星魔神瓦沙克的手一挥，蓝色的灵力萦绕而出。

“这是我之前买的普通酒，味道也就一般，放在里面，混入一两滴月光酿的酒液，施以灵力，味道跟月光酿相差不大。”

“只不过，口味就没有那么醇厚了。”

一想到自家那个爱喝酒的二哥在品尝到这酒之后那震惊的神情，星魔神瓦沙克的唇角根本压不住。

在干坏事的时候，人的想法是真的很多。

“好呀！”

有星魔神瓦沙克这话在，枫溪是放下心来了。

“事不宜迟，瓦沙克叔叔，我们赶紧换吧。”

古有狸猫换太子，现有以次充好调换美酒。

枫溪和星魔神瓦沙克两个人在那动着，没有修为的白玥全程看着。

她的世界观被他们两个给重塑了。

原来，魔族也跟人类一样有血有肉。

真要坑人的时候，他们也是毫不手软的。

白玥默默地为月魔神阿加雷斯祈祷着。

日防夜防、家贼难防！

"Put ordinary wine in his special container, then use magic to seal it and put it in the pool water."

Star Demon God Vasak said calmly, "I know his sealing magic. I'll teach you."

"The method of lifting it consumes less spiritual power than your current method."

Star Demon God Vasak's words undoubtedly touched Feng Xi's heart.

"Yes!"

Fengxi's eyes were bright and she looked at the Star Demon God Vasak with admiration, "Uncle Vasak, you are the smartest demon in the demon clan!"

"With your wisdom, you can definitely deceive Uncle Agares."

Fengxi is now praising the Star Demon God Vasak.

Because she wants Star Demon Lord Vassago to help.

Star Demon God Vasak paused, "Okay."

"But when the time comes, you have to take my door whistle to play."

"A Bao and Mendi are the same age. Anyway, if you have one child, you are a guardian, and if you have two children, you are a guardian."

"My door flute is innocent and gentle, and I'm afraid he will be wronged."

Star Demon God Vasak paused, "It is also a sad thing for him not to have a partner of the same age."

"Okay!"

Fengxi immediately responded, "Uncle Vasak, I can definitely take good care of my brother Mendi!"

"Okay."

With Fengxi's words, Star Demon God Vasak felt relieved.

Star Demon God Vasak waved his hand, and blue spiritual power lingered out.

"This is the ordinary wine I bought before, and the taste is just average. I put it in, mixed one or two drops of Moonlight Brewing liquid, and applied spiritual power. The taste is not much different from Moonlight Brewing."

"It's just that the taste is not that mellow."

Star Demon God Vasak couldn't hold back the corners of his lips when he thought of the shocked look on his second brother who loved to drink after tasting this wine.

When people do bad things, they really have a lot of thoughts.

"Okay!"

With the words of Star Demon God Vasak, Fengxi felt relieved.

"Without further delay, Uncle Vasak, let's change quickly."

In ancient times, civet cats were exchanged for princes, but now inferior goods are exchanged for fine wines.

Fengxi and Star Demon God Vasak were moving there, while Bai Yue, who had no cultivation level, watched the whole process.

Her worldview was reshaped by the two of them.

It turns out that demons are as flesh and blood as humans.

When they really want to trick someone, they show no mercy.

Bai Yue silently prayed for the Moon Demon God Agares.

It’s hard to guard against house thieves by day and night!
